# Pose-free and Feed-forward Training

Also called: Pose-free feed-forward training, Feed-forward 3DGS, Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting

## Overview
This family of methods reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes without iterative per-scene optimization, either by eliminating the need for Structure-from-Motion (SfM) camera poses (pose-free) or by predicting Gaussian parameters directly from images via a neural network (feed-forward) [S1, unofficial]. Unlike standard 3DGS which requires minutes of per-scene differentiable rasterization optimization, these methods enable real-time or near-real-time reconstruction, solving the initialization bottleneck and local minima issues inherent in sparse-view or generalizable settings [S1, unofficial][6464-pixelsplat.md].

## Shared principles
The core mechanism replaces the iterative gradient-based optimization loop of standard 3DGS with a direct mapping from input imagery to Gaussian primitives. This mapping is implemented either as a rapid differentiable optimization initialized by geometric priors (InstantSplat) or as a feed-forward neural network that regresses or samples Gaussian parameters (pixelSplat, AnySplat) [S1, unofficial].

Key shared constraints include:
1.  **Representation:** The output is a set of 3D Gaussian primitives $\{G_i\}$ defined by mean $\mu_i$, covariance $\Sigma_i$, opacity $\alpha_i$, and spherical harmonics coefficients $c_{i,lm}$ [6136-instantsplat.md][6464-pixelsplat.md].
2.  **Rendering:** The predicted Gaussians are rendered using standard differentiable volume rendering/rasterization [6136-instantsplat.md][6464-pixelsplat.md].
3.  **Loss:** Training minimizes photometric reconstruction errors, typically combining L1/MS-SSIM (InstantSplat) or MSE/LPIPS (pixelSplat) between rendered and ground-truth images [6136-instantsplat.md][6464-pixelsplat.md].
4.  **Handling Local Minima:** Standard 3DGS uses non-differentiable pruning/splitting, which breaks gradient flow in feed-forward settings. Feed-forward methods use differentiable sampling from a predicted probability distribution (reparameterization trick) to implicitly manage Gaussian density and location, avoiding local minima where gradients vanish [6464-pixelsplat.md].

## Subtopics

### [InstantSplat](6136-instantsplat.md)
InstantSplat is a pose-free, sparse-view 3DGS training method that eliminates the need for SfM pose estimation by leveraging geometric priors from MASt3R or VGGT [6136-instantsplat.md]. It solves the initialization bottleneck of traditional 3DGS, enabling training from sparse or uncalibrated inputs in seconds [6136-instantsplat.md]. Unlike feed-forward methods like pixelSplat which generate Gaussians via a neural network forward pass, InstantSplat performs rapid differentiable optimization initialized by prior geometry [6136-instantsplat.md]. Choose this method when high-quality reconstruction from sparse, uncalibrated views is required and a few seconds of optimization is acceptable. See [InstantSplat](6136-instantsplat.md).

### [pixelSplat](6464-pixelsplat.md)
pixelSplat is a feed-forward model that reconstructs 3D radiance fields parameterized by 3D Gaussian primitives from pairs of images, enabling real-time, memory-efficient rendering and fast 3D reconstruction at inference time [6464-pixelsplat.md]. It solves the problem of local minima inherent to sparse, locally supported representations in generalizable novel view synthesis, where non-differentiable pruning or splitting cannot be used because gradients must back-propagate through the representation [6464-pixelsplat.md]. Unlike light-field transformers which do not reconstruct editable 3D scene representations, pixelSplat generates an explicit 3D representation that is renderable in real time, remains editable, and is cheap to train [6464-pixelsplat.md]. Choose this method for real-time inference from image pairs with known poses. See [pixelSplat](6464-pixelsplat.md).

### AnySplat
AnySplat is a pose-free feed-forward network where a single forward pass over uncalibrated image collections yields 3D Gaussian primitives plus per-image intrinsics and extrinsics [S1, unofficial]. It scales to casual dense or sparse multi-view captures with no pose annotations, matching pose-aware baselines and surpassing prior pose-free methods (NoPoSplat-class) in zero-shot evaluations at real-time rendering latency [S1, unofficial].

## Background
Originating from the need to accelerate 3DGS training and remove dependencies on SfM pipelines, this family emerged alongside generalizable neural radiance field methods. InstantSplat adapts the 3DGS optimization loop to be pose-free by using foundation model priors (MASt3R/VGGT) for initialization [6136-instantsplat.md]. pixelSplat extends the feed-forward paradigm (previously seen in Splatter Image and MVSplat) to explicit 3D Gaussians, addressing the local minima problem via probabilistic sampling [6464-pixelsplat.md]. AnySplat further generalizes this to uncalibrated multi-view collections [S1, unofficial]. These methods are used in applications requiring rapid reconstruction from casual imagery, mobile deployment, and scenarios where SfM fails or is too slow.
